lead: A `MySqlRows` column description cannot be named outside `nvs-db`, so no caller there can write a helper that takes one.
body: `MySqlRows::columns` answers `&[Column]` where `Column` is `mysql_common::packets::Column`, re-exported nowhere, so `fn read(column: &Column, …)` is unspellable in `nvs-cli` or `nvs-stdlib`. Decode inline in the row loop or behind a helper taking `nvs_db::MySqlScalar`, which is exported; match it by reference, and `to_string()` a `Text`/`Bytes` that outlives the iteration, since it borrows the row.
